approvalChecklist: The page pattern fits the primary user task.
Existing Kaoshi/Hermes components are reused before new ones are proposed.
Loading, empty, error, stale, permission, and mobile states are specified.
Mobbin references are pattern-specific and include do-not-copy notes.
Data source, freshness, schema, and transform ownership are explicit.
Responsive and accessibility evidence is attached or explicitly blocked.
Implementation risks have owners and validation commands.
